verdict.rationale: Abacum documents its own group-based role permissions across the workspace, which gives scoped access. It also documents investor and board reporting where the deck builds itself from live actuals. The evidence never explicitly describes sharing dashboards or reports with board members or teammates, or how access is scoped per recipient. Missing for 10: explicit dashboard/report sharing feature, board or external viewer access, per-report or per-dashboard permission scoping, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, I can share dashboards and reports with the board or team under scoped access

citations.quote: With group-based role assignment, Abacum lets you assign and manage user permissions easily across your workspace
Actuals flow in, the narrative updates, the deck builds itself.
So the number you take to the board is today's, not last close's.
